title: Cactus Is Not That Strong│仙人掌沒那麼強
description: Any item entity is immune to cactus damage.│任何物品實體皆免疫仙人掌傷害。
body:
**⚠️ This data pack requires the server-side mod [Item Components](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-components).│該資料包需要伺服器端模組[物品組件](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-components)。 ⚠️**
# Function│功能
Any entity form of an item is immune to damage from cacti. Currently, this only works with vanilla, the [Copper Extension](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-extension), and [Simple Copper Pipes](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-copper-pipes) items.│任何物品的實體型態皆免疫仙人掌的傷害，目前只對原版以及[銅擴展](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-extension)和[簡單的銅管](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-copper-pipes)的物品有效。
